name: Sony XM5
author: delarosa1312
description: Battery, noise control and equaliser for the Sony WH-1000XM5 and WF-1000XM5. Also needs the mdrctl daemon from the same repository: a bar widget cannot hold a Bluetooth control session on its own. Installing the widget alone is safe -- it appears with no readings and says what is missing -- but it needs one more command to do anything. See the README.

barWidget.description: Battery, noise control and equaliser for the WH-1000XM5 and WF-1000XM5. Needs the mdrctl daemon (same repository).

schema.label: Bluetooth address
schema.description: Only read while mdrctld is stopped, so BlueZ knows which device to report battery for. Leave empty while the daemon runs -- it reports its own address. Find yours with: bluetoothctl devices Connected

schema.label: Display name
schema.description: Shown in the panel header until the headset reports its own model.
